note: Owner-editable follow list (PRD §8). Manual curation — nothing here is scraped or ingested; the card just links out. Handles are stored WITHOUT the leading @; profile URLs are derived from `platform` in lib/follows.js so a typo can't point at the wrong account. Supported platforms: "x", "truthsocial". X accounts decay — re-check this list every few months.

groups.name: Crypto newsfeed
groups.blurb: The speed layer. SignalDesk ingests on a 15-minute cycle, which is fine for a swing read and useless in the first ten minutes of a hack, a listing or a Fed headline. That is what these are for.

accounts.name: Walter Bloomberg
accounts.note: Relays newswire macro headlines within seconds, all-caps, no analysis. The fastest macro on this list — but it is a relay, so the headline lands before anyone has checked the context.

accounts.name: Tree News
accounts.note: Crypto-native breaking-news bot: listings, hacks, filings, often minutes ahead of the newsrooms. Raw and unfiltered — expect the occasional false alarm and correction.

accounts.name: TradFi
accounts.note: Traditional-finance headlines and market chatter — the macro backdrop crypto trades against. Read it for what stocks and rates are reacting to, not for crypto calls.

accounts.name: Donald Trump
accounts.note: Primary source, not a news account — tariffs, Fed pressure and crypto policy get posted here first and move markets directly. The market's reaction is the data; the claim itself is politics.

accounts.name: Zoomerfied
accounts.note: Fast crypto commentary and aggregation. A personality account, so treat a post as a lead to verify — never as confirmation on its own.

accounts.name: CoinDesk
accounts.note: Established newsroom: slower, but checked before it publishes. Already feeding your briefing via RSS, so following on X only buys you speed.

accounts.name: The Block
accounts.note: Research-grade crypto reporting, same role as CoinDesk. Already in your briefing via RSS — X adds speed, not new coverage.

accounts.name: Watcher.Guru
accounts.note: Very fast, very high volume, very low filter. Read the headlines and skip the takes — this account rewards a quick scan and punishes a deep read.
